changes.description: Vermont Judiciary general Certificate of Service. Filing eligibility depends on the selected court and division.

form_metadata_corrections.reason: The official Vermont Judiciary PDF is a general Superior Court Division form, titled “Certificate of Service,” with form ID 600-00264 (01/2026); its heading does not identify the Criminal Division. The general guided interview asks users to choose Civil, Family, Probate, Criminal, or Environmental and the attached template is this same numbered form. The live provider exposes exact filing label “Certificate of Service” across Vermont county profiles, and Vermont Rules for Electronic Filing Rule 11(g)(2) requires filing a certificate in specified cases (non-efiler/no service contact/alternative service). That establishes that a paper-only designation and Criminal-only department are not source-supported; retain null e-fileability pending division-specific eligibility validation rather than asserting universal e-file eligibility.
